description: Pins INSIDE mdapi/joplin-mcp (infra-ik4p.28): the Dockerfile FROM lines and `# renovate:` ARG pins, requirements.txt. Runs from mdapi/fleet's `renovate` job, which lists this repo in RENOVATE_REPOSITORIES; Windmill f/probe/renovate_pin_coverage flags any Dockerfile pin no reader sees. The readers, the house core, OSV alerts, the dependency-proxy alias and the SHA re-pin by mdapi/fleet's installed tools/repin_sha256.py come from the shared preset local>mdapi/renovate-config:image-repo; do not set enabledManagers or postUpgradeTasks here, since a repo value REPLACES the preset's. MR-only baseline: nothing here automerges until a graduation tick says so.
prBodyNotes: Tick one box to change what automerges for this dependency **from now on**. Windmill `f/desk/renovate_graduate` reads the ticks and labels on this repo's Renovate MRs and opens an MR against its `renovate.json`; nothing changes until that MR merges. The label is the durable form — `automerge:digest`, `automerge:minor`, `automerge:major`, `automerge:never` — and works on a merged MR too.
- [ ] <!--grad:{{{packageName}}}:digest--> automerge future **rebuilds of this tag** — digest: same version, new content  ·  label `automerge:digest`
⚠️ `digest` is deliberately NOT implied by the version ticks: on a pinned tag a digest is that release rebuilt, the base-image fix path.

packageRules.description: js-yaml STAYS ON 4.x. The `overrides` pin exists only to force a CVE-fixed js-yaml under @joplin/lib (prototype pollution, fixed in 4.1.1). js-yaml 5 changes what @joplin/lib's front-matter code relies on: load('') throws instead of returning undefined, a bare '---' loads as "" instead of null, an empty string dumps as a bare key that reads back as null, and 'y' loses its quotes. Lift this cap only when @joplin/lib itself depends on js-yaml 5 (Renovate MR !91, closed).

linkify-it STAYS ON 5.x. The `overrides` pin exists only to force a CVE-fixed linkify-it under markdown-it 13 (which asks for ^4). linkify-it 6 changed its CommonJS entry from `module.exports = LinkifyIt` to named exports, so markdown-it 13's `new LinkifyIt()` throws `TypeError: LinkifyIt is not a constructor` the moment a MarkdownIt instance is built. Lift this cap only when the markdown-it that Joplin ships depends on linkify-it 6 (Renovate MR !93, closed).

engines.node is NOT a dependency: it states the node the base image ships (Debian nodejs, python:slim), and .npmrc engine-strict makes the image build fail on any package whose engines exclude it. constraintsFiltering=strict (top level) reads it so no update MR offers a version that needs a newer node (nanoid 6 needs >=22, infra-7ae4x). Change it only together with the base image's node.

GRADUATED — minor+patch (promoted by the graduation tick / Windmill f/desk/renovate_graduate). The baseline here is MR-only, so this list is the whole minor+patch automerge. Must sit above GRADUATED — major. `__none__` is a sentinel, not a package: it keeps an emptied list inert instead of matching everything.

GRADUATED — digest. Automerge a DIGEST update (same tag, rebuilt content) for the packages named here, written by the `automerge:digest` tick or label. ⚠️ PLACEMENT IS THE MECHANISM: must sit ABOVE 'DIGEST CHURN IS ONE MR', whose matchJsonata reads `automerge` as resolved by the rules above it.

⛔ DEMOTED — MR-only whatever else says otherwise. Written by the `automerge:never` tick or label, which ALSO removes the package from every GRADUATED rule — the removal is what makes it bite, since GRADUATED·minor and ·major sit below this rule. ⚠️ Must sit ABOVE 'DIGEST CHURN IS ONE MR': a demoted digest admitted to the shared branch would hold it open for every member.

DIGEST CHURN IS ONE MR — every digest update that automerges shares one branch. matchJsonata reads `automerge` as resolved by the rules ABOVE, which keeps MR-only digests out: a group automerges only if every member does. Must stay below every rule that sets automerge for a digest.

GRADUATED — major. Packages explicitly promoted to MAJOR automerge by the graduation tick or the automerge:major label. A major is a breaking change by definition, so only packages named here automerge one. MUST stay last: packageRules are last-match-wins, and un-graduation is a removal from these lists.
